blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision Transformers deployed in medical imaging exploit spurious correlations, yet the internal mechanisms remain unidentified and impossible to fix. We apply mechanistic interpretability to locate one such mechanism in ViT-Base 16: a single attention head (L8H10) that functions as a dedicated annotation-reader on chest X-rays, attending to corner text rather than lung pathology in 62% of 200 COVID-19 images. Causal validation via inpainting confirms annotation content rather than luminance or edge density drives the behaviour, increasing lung attention 1.52 times upon removal in affected images ($p{<}0.0001$). The finding replicates across NIH ChestX-ray14 (79%), DeiT-Base (88%), and ViT-Large 16 (80%), establishing spurious annotation-attending heads as a consistent property of ViT-family architectures across two datasets and three architectures. Full fine-tuning does not suppress the behaviour and may entrench it: 98.4% of spurious images remain spurious and the spurious rate rises marginally, as the shortcut is reinforced rather than removed. Critically, single-head ablation produces $p{=}0.340$ and multi-head ablation of all three identified carriers produces $p{=}0.532$, meaning a causally verified annotation-reading circuit is completely invisible to output-level evaluation. Mechanistic auditing finds what behavioural testing cannot.
blocks.zh: 在医疗成像中部署的视觉变形器利用了虚假的关联,然而内部机制仍然不明朗并无法修复. 我们运用机械解释能力在ViT-Base 16中找到一个这样的机制:一个单一的注意头(L8H10),它作为胸X射线的专用注释读取器发挥作用,在200个COVID-19图像中,62%的图像中注意角文本而不是肺病. 通过印花进行因果关系验证,证实注解内容,而不是发光或边缘密度,促使行为发生,使受影响图像的肺注意力增加1.52倍(0.0001美元)。 该发现在NIH ChestX-ray14(79%),DeiT-Base(88%)和ViT-Large 16(80%)之间复制,将虚伪的注解取出头作为ViT-家族架构的一致属性,跨越了两个数据集和三个架构. 全面微调并不能抑制行为,并可能使其根深蒂固:98.4%的虚假图像仍然虚假,而虚假率稍有上升,因为快捷方式得到了加强而不是去除。 关键是,单头通航产生0.340美元,所有三个识别载体的多头通航产生0.532美元,即因果核实的注读回路对输出级评价来说是完全看不见的。 机械审计发现行为测试是无法做到的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A chest X-ray classifier can learn to read the hospital code
stamped in the corner of every image rather than the pathology in
the lungs. The model will perform well in-distribution and fail
silently the moment it encounters a new institution. This is not a
hypothetical failure mode. DeGrave et
al. DeGrave et al. (2021) documented it concretely for
COVID-19 classifiers, and Zech et al. Zech et al. (2018) showed the same pattern for pneumonia detection. What neither work
could answer is which components implement the shortcut
internally, and whether removing them would help or simply degrade
performance.

Existing explainability tools like Grad-CAM, attention rollout,
and LIME show where a model attended. They do not identify which
specific component caused it, and they cannot establish causation.
The difference matters for intervention: you cannot fix a mechanism
you have not located.

blocks.en:
This failure mode is acutely consequential in the African and
broader global health context. ViT-based chest X-ray classifiers
are increasingly deployed for tuberculosis and pneumonia screening
in low-resource clinical settings Vanitha et al. (2025) , typically
as models pretrained at a high-resource referral centre and
transferred directly to district hospitals or mobile screening
units with different X-ray equipment, different PACS software, and
different annotation conventions. A model trained at a large
teaching hospital, where the scanner software stamps a facility
code in the top-left corner of every image, may silently read that
code rather than the lung pathology and produce systematically
degraded performance the moment it is deployed at a clinic whose
scanner stamps nothing, or stamps a different code at a different
location. This transfer happens routinely and without mechanistic
re-auditing. Standard accuracy benchmarks, evaluated on held-out
data from the same institution, will not detect it.

blocks.en:
We apply mechanistic interpretability, a toolkit developed for
dissecting language models, to a medical Vision Transformer. We
identify one attention head, L8H10, as a dedicated corner-contrast
detector that reliably attends to annotation text across two
datasets and three architectures. We verify its behaviour causally.
We then ablate it and find no measurable downstream effect at
either the single-head or multi-head level. The head is
safety-relevant and evaluation-invisible. This gap is the central
finding. The three-stage analysis pipeline is summarised in Figure 1 .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Spurious Correlations in Medical AI
blocks.zh: 2.1 医学AI中的纯洁关联

blocks.en:
Shortcut learning in medical AI is well-documented at the
behavioural level. Geirhos et
al. Geirhos et al. (2020) established that deep networks
exploit texture over shape as a general tendency. DeGrave et
al. DeGrave et al. (2021) showed COVID-19 classifiers learned
hospital acquisition artefacts rather than pathological features.
Zech et al. Zech et al. (2018) demonstrated token-level
shortcutting in pneumonia classifiers. The phenomenon is
established. The mechanism is not.

将纹理利用在形状上,作为一般趋势。 德格罗夫公司
阿尔。 DeGrave等人(2021年)介绍了所学COVID-19分类法。
医院购置手工艺品而不是病理特征。

肺炎分类法中的短切 现象是

blocks.en: 2.2 Mechanistic Interpretability
blocks.zh: 2.2 机械解释性

blocks.en:
Olah et al. Olah et al. (2020) showed that specific
interpretable computations like curve detectors and frequency
filters could be identified within convolutional networks.
Elhage et al. Elhage et al. (2021) extended this to
Transformers, identifying induction heads as a concrete functional
circuit. Elhage et al. Elhage et al. (2022) demonstrated
superposition: models encode more features than their
dimensionality permits, with implications for how spurious
associations may be stored compactly in large models.

曲线探测器和频率等可解释的计算

转换器,确定上岗主管为具体职能

社团可以紧紧地储存在大型模型中。

blocks.en:
Application to Vision Transformers remains nascent. Dosovitskiy et
al. Dosovitskiy et al. (2021) introduced the ViT
architecture. Raghu et al. Raghu et al. (2021) characterised ViT representations relative to CNNs. The ViT-Prisma
toolkit Joseph et al. (2024) extended TransformerLens-style
mechanistic analysis to vision models, providing the foundation for
our approach. Mechanistic identification of a
spurious-correlation-implementing circuit in a medical ViT has not,
to our knowledge, been reported.

blocks.en: 2.3 Explainability in Medical Vision Transformers
blocks.zh: 2.3 医疗视觉变形器的解释性

blocks.en:
Chefer et al. Chefer et al. (2021) improved attention
rollout with relevancy propagation. Barekatain et
al. Barekatain et al. (2025) found that explainability
methods disagree substantially with each other on medical ViTs.
Both observations point toward the same gap our work addresses:
correlational explainability is insufficient for intervention.
Knowing where a model attended is not the same as knowing which
component caused it or whether removing that component would help.

推出相关宣传。 乙型六氯环己烷及
阿尔。 Barekatain等人(2025年)认为,可解释性
在医疗VITs上,方法彼此有很大的分歧.
这两项意见都指出了我们的工作所涉及的同样差距:
关联性的解释性不足以进行干预。
了解模特儿在哪里 和了解哪个不一样
组件导致的,或者删除该组件是否有帮助。

blocks.en: 4.1 L8H10 Is a Network-Wide Anomaly
blocks.zh: 4.1 L8H10级 是一个网络-Wide 异常

blocks.en:
Attention specialisation (entropy below 3.0 nats) is absent
in layers 1–6 (mean entropy 5.0–5.2) and emerges abruptly in
layers 7–9(Figure 2 ). Three heads meet the threshold: L7H2 (2.97 nats),
L9H3 (2.91), L8H10 (2.88).

Figure 2: Entropy across 12 layers. Specialisation appears
abruptly in layers 7–9, not gradually, consistent with
functional circuit emergence at intermediate depth, not

blocks.en:
The single-head null result ( p = 0.340 p{=}0.340 ) could reflect two

carriers simultaneously produces no differential effect on

blocks.en: 4.9 Spurious Behaviour Persists Through Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.9 通过精益求精而使行为持久化

blocks.en:
A critical question for clinical deployment is whether
task-specific fine-tuning suppresses L8H10’s
annotation-reading behaviour. We tested two regimes.
blocks.zh:
临床部署的一个关键问题是:
任务特定的微调抑制 L8H10 的
注释阅读行为. 我们测试了两种制度。

blocks.en:
We updated only the last
two transformer layers and classification head for 5 epochs
(AdamW, lr=2e-5). The spurious rate changed from 61.5% to
61.0%, a reduction of one image in 200. Of 123 originally
spurious images, 122 (99.2%) remained spurious.

我们只更新了最后一份
5个纪元的两个变压器层和分类头
(中文(简体) ). 虚假比率从61.5%改为
61.0%,每200人减少一幅图像. 原123个
122幅(99.2%)的虚假图像仍然不实。

We updated all 12 transformer
layers for 15 epochs using layerwise learning rate decay
(base lr=2e-5, decay factor 0.85 per layer toward input),
cosine annealing, and gradient clipping at 1.0. The spurious rate
was 62.5%, marginally higher than pretrained. Of 123
originally spurious images, 121 (98.4%) remained spurious
after full fine-tuning. The mean corner/lung ratio declined
from 35.6 × \times to 29.2 × \times (Wilcoxon p = 0.009 p{=}0.009 ),
but this shift is practically negligible: a ratio of
29 × \times represents the same catastrophic
annotation-dominance as 36 × \times .

使用分层学习速率衰减的15个纪元的层
(基准lr=2e-5,每层0.85衰变系数对输入),
余弦反射, 和渐变剪切在1.0。 虚率

从35.6\时到29.2\时(Wilcoxon p = 0.009 p{=}0.09),

blocks.en:
The fine-tuning objective does not provide a gradient signal that
contradicts corner-reading, because annotation text is correlated
with institutional disease prevalence in the training data. The
shortcut remains predictive throughout fine-tuning and is therefore
never penalised by the loss function. The slight increase in
spurious rate under full fine-tuning (61.5% → \to 62.5%) is
consistent: full fine-tuning strengthens task-relevant
representations, and because corner-reading is task-relevant in a
dataset with consistent annotation conventions, it is reinforced
rather than suppressed.
The practical implication is direct: the standard ViT
deployment pipeline, pretraining on ImageNet and fine-tuning on locally
labelled clinical data, does not remove spurious
annotation-reading and may entrench it. A practitioner who
fine-tunes a pretrained ViT on chest X-rays from their institution
and then transfers the model to another site should not assume that
fine-tuning has cleaned up shortcut behaviour. Our results show it
has almost certainly preserved it, and may have made it worse.
Ablation-based mitigation strategies are structurally
insufficient: the spurious signal is distributed across redundant
components that collectively resist targeted removal. The only
known reliable mitigations are data-level, namely training on
annotation-stripped images so the shortcut is never learned, or
training-time regularisation explicitly targeting identified
spurious heads. Both require first knowing which heads to target.
This is exactly what mechanistic auditing provides.
blocks.zh:
微调目标不提供梯度信号,即:
与角读相矛盾, 因为注释文本是相关的
在培训数据中反映机构疾病流行情况。 这个
在整个微调过程中,快捷方式仍然具有预测性,因此
从未受到损失函数的惩罚。 略有增加
完全微调后的虚报率(61.5%~~~-62.5%)是:
一致性:全面微调加强任务相关
说明,并由于角读与任务有关

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Structural Blindness in Output-Level Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 产出评价中的结构盲度

blocks.en:
The null ablation result is a specific, falsifiable claim about
the structure of how neural networks encode information, with
direct implications for how AI safety evaluation is currently
conducted.
blocks.zh:
无效赔偿结果是一项可伪造的具体索赔,涉及:
神经网络如何编码信息的结构,
对AI目前安全评价方式的直接影响
进行。

blocks.en:
Elhage et al. Elhage et al. (2022) showed that Transformers
operating near capacity encode features in superposition: each
feature is distributed across many components. This creates a
fundamental asymmetry between what mechanistic analysis can detect
and what output-level evaluation can detect.
blocks.zh:
Elhage等人著. Elhage等人(2022年)表明,变形器
在叠加位置操作近容量编码特性:每个
特性分布在许多组成部分。 这创造了一个
机械分析能够发现的
以及产出一级的评价能够发现什么。

blocks.en:
Output-level evaluation (accuracy, confidence, prediction
change rate) measures the aggregate behaviour of the
network. It is blind to individual component behaviour unless
that component is both non-redundant and causally upstream of
the output. In a network with distributed representations,
neither condition holds for most components. A head can
implement a clearly spurious computation yet produce no output-level
signal when ablated, because the network reconstructs the same
output from the remaining redundant encoding.
blocks.zh:
产出评价(准确性、信心、预测)
变化率)衡量
腾讯网. 除非
该部分既无重复性,又因果上上游
输出。 在一个分布式代表的网络中,
大多数组件都不具备条件。 一个头可以
执行明显虚假的计算,但没有产生输出级别
减速时发出信号,因为网络重建相同
输出来自剩余冗余编码。

blocks.en:
The danger is not that L8H10 will cause the classifier to fail
on a single image. The danger is that the entire family of
spurious annotation-reading components constitutes a latent
vulnerability that activates silently under distributional shift.
When a model trained at one institution is deployed at another
with different annotation conventions, this distributed spurious
signal may suddenly dominate, and no output-level evaluation
performed at the training site will have detected it.
blocks.zh:
危险不是L8H10会导致分类器失败
在单一的图像。 危险是整个家庭
虚假的注解读取组件构成潜在的
在分配转变下静静地激活的脆弱性。
当一个机构培训的模型在另一个机构部署时
有不同的注解公约,这种分布的虚假
信号可能突然占据主导地位,没有输出级评价
将在训练场进行检测。

blocks.en:
This is particularly consequential for ViT-based deployment
in low-resource clinical settings Vanitha et al. (2025) ,
where models are routinely transferred from high-resource
pretraining environments to new institutions without
re-auditing. The annotation conventions at the source
institution are encoded in the model’s weights and will
transfer silently — invisible to any accuracy benchmark
evaluated on source-domain data.
blocks.zh:
这对基于虚拟技术的部署特别不利
在低资源临床环境中,Vanitha等人(2025年),
定期从高资源转移模型
预训环境到新机构
重新审计。 来源说明公约
机构在模型的权重和意志中编码
静悄悄地转移——任何精确基准都看不见
根据源域数据进行评估。

blocks.en:
Current deployment evaluation for medical AI relies almost
entirely on output-level metrics: accuracy on held-out data,
performance under distribution shift, occasionally gradient
attribution maps. Our results demonstrate that this evaluation
regime is structurally blind to a specific and dangerous
failure class: components that implement shortcuts at the
representational level but whose contribution is masked by
redundant encoding at the output level. This is not a
measurement problem that better ablation methods can solve;
it is a consequence of the architecture itself.
Standard evaluation answers: does the model perform
correctly on this data? Mechanistic auditing answers: which components are responsible, and are any doing so
for the wrong reasons? These questions are not interchangeable,
and our results show a model can answer the first correctly while
failing the second catastrophically.
Mechanistic auditing of attention concentration, identification
of spurious-signal carriers, and causal verification of their
behaviour should be standard components of any pre-deployment
audit for Vision Transformers applied to medical imaging,
especially when models cross institutional boundaries.
blocks.zh:
目前对医疗AI的部署评估几乎依赖于

对用于医疗成像的视觉变形器进行审计,
特别是当模型跨越机构界限时。

blocks.en: 5.2 Mechanistic Interpretability Transfers to Vision Models
blocks.zh: 5.2 向愿景模型的转移

blocks.en:
Entropy analysis, attention distance metrics, and activation
patching developed for language models apply directly to ViT
attention heads with minimal modification. The abrupt
specialisation emergence in layers 7–9 mirrors functional circuit
emergence at intermediate depths in language models, suggesting the
phenomenon is architecture-general. Whether it extends to Swin,
BEiT, other medical modalities, or other pretraining regimes is an
open question.

blocks.en: 5.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.3 限制

blocks.en:
The corner region definition (top-left 3 × 3 3{\times}3 patches)
and spurious threshold (corner/lung ratio > 2 {>}2 ) were chosen
to match the annotation convention of the datasets used here.
Datasets where annotations appear at other locations would require
adjusting the region definition accordingly. The underlying method
generalises directly: head identification depends only on max
single-patch attention concentration and mean attention distance,
neither of which assumes a specific annotation location.

单点注意力集中 和平均注意力距离,

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning experiments used 200 images, which is small
relative to clinical training sets. The theoretical
argument for why suppression fails applies regardless of dataset
size when annotation conventions are consistent. The definitive
experiment would compare fine-tuning on annotation-consistent
versus annotation-stripped datasets of matched size; we
identify this as the most important direction for future work.

相对于临床培训。 理论
压制失败的理由,无论数据集如何

实验可以比较与注释一致的微调
相对于大小相匹配的注解抽取数据集;

blocks.en: 5.4 Future Work
blocks.zh: 5.4 今后的工作

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning on annotation-stripped images would directly
test whether suppressing the spurious signal during training
prevents it from being encoded. Automated spurious head
detection , flagging heads with anomalously high max-attention
concentration as a pre-deployment screening step, would make
this analysis practical without per-model manual inspection. Extension to other modalities (retinal imaging,
dermoscopy, CT) would establish whether the phenomenon is
specific to chest X-rays or broader.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We identified a single attention head, L8H10 in ViT-Base/16,
as a dedicated corner-contrast detector that attends to annotation
text in 62% of clinical chest X-rays, with a corner-to-lung
attention ratio 74.8 × \times higher in affected images than
unaffected ones ( p < 0.0001 p{<}0.0001 ). Two causal interventions confirm
annotation content drives the behaviour. Replication on NIH
ChestX-ray14 (79% rate, 37.9 × \times separation) and across
DeiT-Base and ViT-Large/16 confirm generalisation across datasets
and architectures, with all three ViT-family models developing spurious
annotation-attending heads at majority rates.

blocks.en: Ethical Statement
blocks.zh: 道德声明

blocks.en:
This study uses only publicly available, de-identified chest X-ray
datasets (COVID-19 Chest X-ray Dataset and NIH ChestX-ray14). No
new patient data were collected. All datasets were used in
accordance with their respective licences and intended research
purposes. The work identifies safety risks in deployed medical AI
systems and does not introduce any new harms.

根据各自的许可证和打算进行的研究
目标。 这项工作查明了部署的医务机构的安全风险。
并且不会带来任何新的伤害。
